_note: 원문 유형은 장문 제목+어휘. title 과 vocab 유형을 가장 강하게 출제. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: Ordinary businesses chase predictability, especially when it comes to the quality of their products.
Professional sport, however, does not always prize such certainty.
For spectators, the experience feels richer precisely when the outcome is in doubt.
In fact, sport leans on unpredictability to draw crowds to the game.
When results cannot be foreseen, attendances and league profits both tend to rise.
Yet that same unpredictability also creates wide swings in the quality of the performance.
Marketers try to manage this by 'improving' the product, adding star players or premium seats.
choices: why commercial businesses always outperform sporting leagues
how star players are recruited by professional sport teams
why ticket prices should change with the weather on game day
how spectators can predict the winners of close contests
how sport relies on unpredictability yet must manage its uneven quality
theme.explanation_ko: 스포츠는 예측 불가능성으로 관중을 끌지만, 그것이 경기 질의 큰 변동을 낳아 마케터가 이를 관리하려 한다는 내용. ⑤가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①일반 기업의 우월, ②스타 영입, ③티켓 가격, ④승자 예측은 본문의 핵심이 아니다.

passage: We should not assume that what works for ordinary business works for sport as well.
Companies aim for predictable, certain product quality, but sport often does the opposite.
From the fan's seat, a contest is more thrilling when no one knows how it will end.
We must see that sport actually depends on this uncertainty to fill its stadiums.
Unpredictable results raise both attendance and the profits of leagues.
Still, the same uncertainty makes the quality of any given match vary widely.
We ought to embrace sport's unpredictability while wisely managing its uneven quality.
choices: 스포츠 경기는 결과를 미리 예측할 수 있어야 흥행한다.
스포츠 구단은 일반 기업의 경영 방식을 그대로 따라야 한다.
관중 수는 경기의 질과 아무런 관련이 없다.
스포츠의 예측 불가능성을 받아들이되 들쭉날쭉한 질은 현명하게 관리해야 한다.
스타 선수를 영입하면 경기 결과를 예측할 수 있다.
claim.explanation_ko: 스포츠의 예측 불가능성을 받아들이되 그로 인한 질의 변동은 관리해야 한다는 주장. ④가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①예측 가능 흥행, ②기업 방식 모방, ③관중·질 무관, ⑤스타로 예측은 본문 주장과 어긋난다.

passage: Most companies want their product quality to be predictable and certain.
Professional sport is different: it often thrives on uncertainty instead.
Fans enjoy a game most when its result is genuinely in doubt.
Sport therefore depends on unpredictability to bring people to the stands.
Unforeseeable outcomes lift both attendance figures and league profits.
But that unpredictability also makes match quality rise and fall sharply.
So marketers work to 'improve' the product with stars, premium seats, and extra entertainment.
choices: 관중은 결과가 분명한 경기를 더 좋아한다.
일반 기업은 스포츠보다 항상 더 큰 이윤을 낸다.
스포츠는 예측 불가능성으로 흥행하지만 그것이 경기 질의 변동을 낳는다.
스타 선수는 경기의 불확실성을 없애 준다.
날씨는 경기 결과에 거의 영향을 주지 않는다.
gist.explanation_ko: 예측 불가능성이 흥행을 부르지만 경기 질의 큰 변동도 함께 낳는다는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①분명한 결과, ②기업 이윤, ④스타의 불확실성 제거, ⑤날씨는 요지가 아니다.

passage: In ordinary business, predictability and certainty are prized above almost everything.
Sport refuses to play by that rule, at least when the contest itself is concerned.
To the watching fan, a match is best when its ending cannot be guessed.
Indeed, sport feeds on that very unpredictability to pull crowds through the gates.
When no one can call the result, attendances climb and so do league profits.
Yet the same wild uncertainty swings the quality of play from brilliant to dull.
Marketers chase that swing, 'improving' the show with stars, premium seats, and extras.
choices: How Businesses Guarantee a Perfect Product Every Time
Unpredictability in Sport: Both a Blessing and a Challenge
Why Fans Prefer Matches with Predictable Endings
Star Players: The Only Path to a Profitable League
Weather and Crowds: The True Causes of Defeat
title.explanation_ko: 스포츠의 예측 불가능성이 흥행이라는 축복이자 질 변동이라는 도전이 됨을 압축한 ②가 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①완벽한 제품, ③예측 가능 선호, ④스타 영입, ⑤날씨·관중은 글의 초점이 아니다.

passage: Businesses crave certainty, but sport often turns that craving on its head.
Fans find a contest most alive when its outcome hangs in the balance.
Sport therefore relies on unpredictability to fill its seats.
When results cannot be predicted, both attendance and profits rise.
But the same uncertainty means the quality of play is a moving target.
A match may dazzle, bore, or frustrate, yet fans pay the very same price.
Marketers chase a moving target when they try to 'improve' the sporting product.
implication.underlined: the quality of play is a moving target
choices: players physically move faster as the season goes on
spectators aim at targets during certain sporting events
ticket prices shift constantly throughout a single match
the standard of a game keeps changing and cannot be fixed in advance
the best teams always hit their performance goals
implication.explanation_ko: '경기의 질은 움직이는 표적'이라는 비유는 경기 수준이 계속 변해 미리 고정할 수 없다는 뜻이다. ④가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①선수 속도, ②실제 표적, ③티켓 가격, ⑤목표 달성은 비유의 의미와 다르다.

passage: Commercial businesses aim for predictability, especially when it comes to product quality.
But such certainty is not always valued in the delivery of professional sport.
From a spectator's perspective, the sport experience is better when it is unpredictable.
Sport events actually depend on that unpredictability for attract people to the game.
When the results of games cannot be predicted, attendances are likely to be higher.
Many factors can contribute to the variability of the sport product, including the weather and player injuries.
Sport marketers may attempt to overcome this by improving the product in systematic ways.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ '사람들을 끌어들이기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내므로 '전치사 for + 동사원형'(for attract)이 아니라 목적의 to부정사 'to attract' 가 와야 한다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①관용구 when it comes to, ②수동태 valued, ④부대상황 분사 including, ⑤전치사 by + 동명사 improving(개선함으로써)은 모두 옳다.

passage: Commercial businesses aim for unpredictability and certainty, especially in product quality.
But predictability is not always valued in professional sport competitions.
From a spectator's perspective the sport experience is better when it is unpredictable.
Sport events actually depend on unpredictability in order to attract people to the game.
When results cannot be predicted, attendances and league profits are likely to be higher.
However, this uncertainty also leads to significant variability in the quality of performances.
Marketers may attempt to overcome this by 'improving' the product in systematic ways.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 일반 기업은 '확실성'과 함께 '예측 가능성(predictability)'을 추구한다는 것이 글의 전제이다. '예측 불가능성(unpredictability)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하므로 predictability 로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②valued(가치 있게 여겨지는), ③unpredictability(스포츠가 의존하는 예측 불가능성), ④higher(더 높은 관중·수익), ⑤variability(질의 변동성)는 문맥에 적절하다.

irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '스포츠의 예측 불가능성이 흥행과 질 변동을 낳는다'는 흐름인데 ④ '경기장의 태양광 패널로 전기료 절감'은 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 스포츠의 예측 불가능성과 그 결과라는 흐름에 연결된다.

order.given: Commercial businesses aim for predictability and certainty, especially when it comes to product quality. But these are not always valued in the sporting world.

blocks.A: From a spectator's perspective the sport experience is better when unpredictable. Sport events actually depend on that unpredictability in order to attract people to the game.
blocks.B: However, the unpredictability also leads to significant variability in the quality of sporting performances. A match can be exhilarating, boring or even frustrating, but fans still pay the same price.
blocks.C: When the results of games cannot be predicted, attendances at sporting contests are likely to be higher, as are the profits of leagues.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글이 '스포츠 세계는 예측 가능성을 늘 중시하진 않는다'로 끝나면, (A)가 그 이유(팬은 불확실할 때 더 즐김)를, (C)가 그 결과(관중·수익 증가)를, (B)가 'However' 로 그 이면(질의 변동)을 제시한다. (A)-(C)-(B). ③이 정답.
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'However ... 그러나 변동성'은 흥행이라는 긍정 결과(C) 뒤의 반전이므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (C)는 (A)의 불확실성 의존을 받아야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: However, the unpredictability also leads to significant variability in the quality of sporting performances.

passage_marked.text: Commercial businesses aim for predictability, but sport does not always value it.
From a spectator's perspective, the sport experience is better when unpredictable.
Sport events actually depend on that unpredictability to attract people to the game.
When results cannot be predicted, attendances and league profits are likely to be higher.
A match can be exhilarating, boring or even frustrating, but fans still pay the same price.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 'However ... 예측 불가능성이 경기 질의 큰 변동도 낳는다'로, 흥행이라는 긍정 결과(④ 문장) 다음, 그리고 경기가 흥미롭거나 지루할 수 있다는 변동의 구체 예(⑤ 문장) 앞에 와야 한다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ④에 넣지 않으면 'A match can be exhilarating, boring or even frustrating' 라는 질의 변동 예시가 가리킬 'variability' 진술이 앞에 나타나지 않는다.

passage: Ordinary businesses prize predictable product quality.
Professional sport, by contrast, often thrives on uncertainty.
Fans enjoy a contest most when its result is in doubt.
Sport depends on this unpredictability to draw crowds and raise profits.
But the same uncertainty makes performance quality vary sharply.
A game may thrill or bore, though fans pay the same price.
Marketers try to 'improve' the product to manage this variability.
summary.summary_template: While businesses seek certainty, sport thrives on __(A)__, which attracts fans but also makes the quality of performances highly __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 스포츠는 (A)예측 불가능성(unpredictability)으로 흥하지만, 그것이 경기 질을 매우 (B)변동적(variable)으로 만든다. ②.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 predictability/safety 가 아니라 unpredictability, (B)는 stable/fixed/equal 이 아니라 variable 이어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 스포츠 행사는 실제로 사람들을 경기로 끌어들이기 위해 그 예측 불가능성에 의존한다.
writing.answer: Sport events depend on that unpredictability to attract people to the game.
writing.explanation_ko: depend on(~에 의존하다) + 목적의 to부정사 to attract people to the game.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 관중의 관점에서, 스포츠 경험은 예측 불가능할 때 더 잘 경험된다.
writing.answer: From a spectator's perspective the sport experience is better when unpredictable.
writing.explanation_ko: 전치사구 From a spectator's perspective + 주어 the sport experience + is better + when (it is) unpredictable.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 경기 결과가 예측될 수 없을 때, 관중 수가 더 높아질 가능성이 크다.
conditions: 조동사 수동태 cannot be predicted 를 사용할 것
be likely to 를 사용할 것
writing.answer: When the results cannot be predicted, attendances are likely to be higher.
writing.explanation_ko: When + 조동사 수동태 cannot be predicted, 주절 be likely to be higher(더 높을 가능성이 크다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: The unpredictability of sport also leads to significant ___________ in the quality of sporting performances.
writing.explanation_ko: 예측 불가능성은 경기 질의 큰 '변동성(variability)'으로 이어진다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Sport marketers may attempt to overcome this by 'improving' the product in systematic ways, such as including a star player or offering premium seating.
writing.answer: 스포츠 마케터들은 스타 선수를 포함하거나 프리미엄 좌석을 제공하는 것과 같이 체계적인 방식으로 제품을 '개선함'으로써 이것을 극복하려 시도할 수 있다.
writing.explanation_ko: attempt to overcome(극복하려 시도하다), by 'improving'(개선함으로써), such as(~와 같은).
